title: Very disappointed. Cheap. Not worth the cost.
text: Very disappointed. Cheap. Not worth the cost.. This was a failure. It took forever to bake the waffles. They didn't taste right, almost like the silicone. I won't use it again. I bought a mini electric waffle maker.
